title: HydroPulse v2.2.3 - Sub-300ms Actuation, 1.5s Offline SLA & Verified Live Hardware MQTT Ping/Pong
changelog: Verified Live Hardware MQTT Ping/Pong: Backend actively tests physical hardware connectivity over HiveMQ before reporting status, completely eliminating mock or cached states.
Sub-300ms Actuation Round-Trip: Microsecond GPIO relay actuation directly in Core 0 mqttCallback with plaintext START_OK/STOP_OK and retained state sync.
Strict 1.5-Second Heartbeat SLA: 500ms dedicated heartbeats feed a strict 1500ms watchdog with immediate MQTT LWT availability trigger.
Persistent Connection Keepalive: Tuned MQTT keepalive to 5 seconds with non-blocking 1000ms reconnect loop (no delay() in control path).
Decoupled Multi-Node Tracking: Independent Main Node and Sub Node heartbeats eliminate online/offline flickering and preserve manual pump control.
Zero Blocking Delays: Relay switching and hardware state verification execute immediately upon command arrival.
